field_principles.arc_registry_precheck_path_hash_and_resu: Proves selected cells are not registry targets.

field_principles.hidden_game_source_access_count: Must stay zero for hidden-source discipline.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict with no solve claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares live-agent no-LLM shadow measurement with upstream model receipts.
field_principles.levels_credited: Must stay zero because no level credit is requested.
field_principles.live_agent_entrypoint_and_e3_policy_hash: Pins the submitted entrypoint and policy source.

field_principles.prospective_action_support_by_arm: Shows unsupported proposals were never applied.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Confirms protected files stayed unchanged during the run.
field_principles.registry_update_count: Must stay zero because no solve is banked.
field_principles.route_reachability_by_model_window_and_s: Measures whether the route can be reached.
field_principles.selected_game_level_and_nonduplicate_rea: Freezes games and levels before attempts.
field_principles.solve_claimed: Must be false because this is route readiness only.
field_principles.solve_provenance: States live-agent self-discovery without solve credit.
field_principles.source_bfs_adapter_prior_game_hidden_sta: Must stay zero for escape-hatch discipline.
field_principles.status: States complete versus blocked without hiding partial work.
field_principles.submitted_config_pre_and_post_hashes: Shows shadow construction did not mutate submitted config.
field_principles.supported_unsupported_and_abstained_prop: Separates supported, unsupported, and abstained proposals.
field_principles.target_license_evidence_receipts: Shows route checks used target runtime evidence.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because no game oracle verifies a solve.
